desc: Ideation: parity-split recursion with shift parameter (f0/f1/h1), direct-sum formulas, termination and complexity analysis (O(N log M))
Implement solve() with f0/f1/h1 recursions, fast I/O, correct handling of i<=j pairs and zeros in shifted subproblems
Verify the implementation logic against samples and edge cases by hand-tracing the code: sample 1 → 5, sample 2 → 384, N=1, all-odd, all-even, A_i=1 zeros handling, formula correctness
